mapper.select: SELECT result_id AS resultId, participant_id AS participantId, session_id AS sessionId, persona_id AS personaId, initial_asset AS initialAsset, final_asset AS finalAsset, return_rate AS returnRate, rt_score AS rtScore, lh_score AS lhScore, rp_score AS rpScore, final_tick AS finalTick, final_price AS finalPrice, finished_at AS finishedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM event_game_results WHERE participant_id = #{participantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_game_results ( participant_id, session_id, persona_id, initial_asset, final_asset, return_rate, rt_score, lh_score, rp_score, final_tick, final_price, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{participantId}, #{sessionId}, #{personaId}, #{initialAsset}, #{finalAsset}, #{returnRate}, #{rtScore}, #{lhScore}, #{rpScore}, #{finalTick}, #{finalPrice}, #{finishedAt} )
